fullContentHtml:
RPSC APO Final Answer Key / Marks 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the final answer key / marks for the post of Assistant Prosecution Officer APO. This recruitment was released for 371 posts. Applications for Rajasthan RPSC APO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 June 2026 to 07 July 2026. The written examination was conducted on 02 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their RPSC APO Final Answer Key / Marks 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 08 June 2026
  • Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 26 August 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 30 August 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27 December 2026
  • Pre Answer Key : 07 September 2026
  • Pre Result : 01 October 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 05 October 2026
  • Marks : 01 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RPSC APO Final Answer Key / Marks 2026?

RPSC APO Final Answer Key / Marks 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
